name: JTBD2 — Problem refresh triage (jobs + schedule)
description: Job-performance JTBD triage path combining two tools. Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and site-admin PAT on Tableau Cloud. Model should cross-reference list-jobs (recent failures) with list-extract-refresh-tasks (the task's schedule) to triage the problem refresh. On the test site there are zero failures; the load driver is an hourly cadence on a large extract, not failures. Read-only.
prompt: Triage the problem extract refresh on this site: check for recent job failures AND look up the task's schedule to explain the load. Use both list-jobs and list-extract-refresh-tasks. Report whether failures are the issue or whether the schedule cadence is the driver. Do not modify anything.
